why: The backend was built quickly as a prototype and had never been checked on the database it really runs on (PostgreSQL), had no automatic test run, created its database tables in two competing ways, and ran on library versions with known security problems. Money and customer orders depend on all of this. Without a verified foundation, every later fix (wallet ledger, queues, scaling) could break silently. This phase makes the foundation checkable by one command, so a finished phase can be proven and stay locked.
approach: Tests now run against a real PostgreSQL as well as SQLite, GitHub runs them on every change, the database layout is built only by Alembic migrations, the web framework and its security-sensitive libraries were upgraded, and a single 'phase gate' command re-checks everything (tests, image-prompt quality, security advisories, load results, a live boot, read-only production check, staging pooler write test) and writes a report.

decisions.decision: Run the PostgreSQL tests on a throw-away local server installed through pip (pgserver), one private schema per test.
decisions.why: SQLite has no row locks, so money races were never truly tested. pgserver needs no Docker or admin rights on Windows and gives each test an isolated schema.

alternatives.why_not: Not available on this machine; would block local verification.

alternatives.option: Test against the hosted Supabase database
alternatives.why_not: Would risk real customer data; a guard now refuses it.

decisions.decision: The database layout is built only by Alembic migrations; the app refuses to start in production if the database revision is behind or unknown.
decisions.why: Two ways of creating tables had already caused drift. One owner of the schema removes that class of bug.

alternatives.why_not: Hides missing migrations and drifts from production.

decisions.decision: Use a constraints file and pinned requirements instead of a pip-compile lock.
decisions.why: Simpler to review and works with the existing setup; installs are still reproducible.

alternatives.why_not: Adds a tool and a generated file for no extra safety at this size.

decisions.decision: Upgrade to FastAPI 0.133.1 and Starlette 1.7.0 now, but defer the Pillow 12 upgrade.
decisions.why: The framework upgrade closes known advisories. Pillow decides image output, so upgrading it needs a before/after image check and the owner's decision.

alternatives.why_not: Could silently change generated image quality.

decisions.why: It made Python treat the local folder as the Alembic library, so migrations could not be imported.

decisions.decision: Lock image quality with a hash snapshot of all 60 prompt variants.
decisions.why: Prompts decide image quality; any accidental change now fails the gate with no paid calls.

decisions.decision: Treat the pooler 'backend changes' observation as informational only.
decisions.why: An idle pooler can legitimately hand one client the same server connection, so the check was too strict to be a real pass/fail.

decisions.decision: A phase counts as locked only if the gate says LOCKED and GitHub CI is green on the same commit.
decisions.why: Local checks and Linux checks catch different problems; both are needed.

decisions.decision: Gate says LOCKED only if every required step ran and passed; skipping one makes it NOT LOCKED.
decisions.why: A review showed --skip could previously still print LOCKED.

errors.cause: An empty backend/alembic/__init__.py shadowed the Alembic library.

errors.error: CI PostgreSQL step reported green although tests failed
errors.cause: Output was piped through tee/grep without pipefail.
errors.fix: Run the step with shell: bash and fail on skipped PostgreSQL tests.

errors.error: Test database guard bypassed with ?host= in the URL
errors.cause: The guard looked at the host text, not the parsed URL.
errors.fix: Parse with make_url, reject host/hostaddr/service/passfile keys, check every comma-separated host; tests added.

errors.error: Database newer than code was treated as 'behind'
errors.fix: Added a 'known revision' flag and a clear refusal message.

errors.error: Concurrency tests exhausted the connection pool before the barrier released
errors.cause: 100 threads each took a connection before waiting.
errors.fix: Wait at the barrier first, then take a connection.

errors.error: pip: FastAPI 0.133.1 did not move Starlette
errors.cause: Dependency range allowed the old Starlette.
Server output pipe was never read and filled up.

errors.error: Pooler check reported FAIL on a healthy staging database
errors.cause: My check assumed backends must change between transactions.

errors.error: A commit swept in the owner's pre-staged files
errors.cause: Commit without an explicit path list.
errors.fix: Soft-reset and recommitted by explicit pathspec; all later commits use pathspecs.

errors.error: PostgreSQL gate step failed twice once, then passed 703 tests on re-run
errors.cause: Intermittent under machine load; the failing tests were never captured. A static review found short pool/barrier/lock-wait timeouts and silent thread deaths in the concurrency tests.
errors.fix: Pool timeout 15s to 120s, barriers 20-30s to 120s, lock-wait query narrowed, thread errors collected and asserted, schema drop gets a lock timeout. Gate also now fails if a required step is skipped. Two later full PostgreSQL runs and one gate run passed; cannot prove the flake is gone, only that it did not recur.
